findings.summary: U7 has zero power: every test in test/g4c-generate-wiring.test.ts injects its own generateDeps stub (20 injection sites), so the production assembleGenerateDeps — whose spawnAnchorCheck throws AnchorCheckNotWiredError (src/tick-run.ts:1322-1324) — is never exercised by any test. The spec U7 explicitly requires the assertion to be on the production-assembled dep and that T5 (changing the production default to return {defects:0,verificationRate:0}) must be killed; with the current tests T5 would NOT be killed. This is the exact zero-power failure mode spec §3 U7 warns about ('所有用例都自建 GenerateDeps 注入自己的 stub，生产默认从未被执行').

U10 evidence is missing the mandated pasted command output. Spec U10 requires '⛔ 必须实跑并贴完整尾部输出（Test Files / Tests 两行 + 有无 FAIL 段）'. The dev-note (docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g4cv2_generate_wiring_01.md:17) only states a summary count ('全量 22 files / 408 tests 全绿') without pasting the actual `npx vitest run` tail output. The spec's most-emphasized rule (§0) is '评审判过 ≠ 命令跑过', and the previous development failed dd acceptance precisely because npm test was red despite final-review APPROVE. Without the actual pasted output the green claim is unverified.
